Field names DFU_SERVICE / DFU_PACKET / DFU_CONTROL_POINT / DFU_VERSION confirm the Nordic DFU spec. Distributed inside the Android-DFU-Library and bundled by many Nordic-chip-based BLE products' apps..

UUID_purpose: Custom GATT Service observed in Android app com.LLE2023. No Java field-name hint available (likely an obfuscated identifier). Shared-SDK signal: this UUID appeared in many host apps whose package vendors don't share any token, so the original SDK vendor isn't visible from the host-app side. Phase-4 identification (scripts/list_shared_sdk_clusters.py) will upgrade this record. Phase-4 SDK identification: Nordic Semiconductor DFU (Device Firmware Update) service. The 0002a5d5c51b suffix is Nordic's node ID, the d2cc-11e4 middle is the UUIDv1 timestamp at design time. Field names DFU_SERVICE / DFU_PACKET / DFU_CONTROL_POINT / DFU_VERSION confirm the Nordic DFU spec. Distributed inside the Android-DFU-Library and bundled by many Nordic-chip-based BLE products' apps..

Shared-SDK signal: this UUID appeared in many host apps whose package vendors don't share any token, so the original SDK vendor isn't visible from the host-app side. Phase-4 identification (scripts/list_shared_sdk_clusters.py) will upgrade this record. Phase-4 SDK identification: Nordic Semiconductor DFU (Device Firmware Update) service. The 0002a5d5c51b suffix is Nordic's node ID, the d2cc-11e4 middle is the UUIDv1 timestamp at design time. Field names DFU_SERVICE / DFU_PACKET / DFU_CONTROL_POINT / DFU_VERSION confirm the Nordic DFU spec. Distributed inside the Android-DFU-Library and bundled by many Nordic-chip-based BLE products' apps..

UUID_purpose: Custom GATT Characteristic observed in Android app com.LLE2023, declared as Java field `DFU_VERSION`. Classification determined by naming-convention. Shared-SDK signal: this UUID appeared in many host apps whose package vendors don't share any token, so the original SDK vendor isn't visible from the host-app side. Phase-4 identification (scripts/list_shared_sdk_clusters.py) will upgrade this record. Phase-4 SDK identification: Nordic Semiconductor DFU (Device Firmware Update) service. The 0002a5d5c51b suffix is Nordic's node ID, the d2cc-11e4 middle is the UUIDv1 timestamp at design time. Field names DFU_SERVICE / DFU_PACKET / DFU_CONTROL_POINT / DFU_VERSION confirm the Nordic DFU spec. Distributed inside the Android-DFU-Library and bundled by many Nordic-chip-based BLE products' apps..
